title: Exercise the migrated buffer cases in Intel backend builds
problem: Intel SYCL and icpx OpenMP build targets still omitted buffer-specific regression cases after both API paths gained the shared engine.
design: Add BUFFER_TESTS to these two source lists only after migration makes their grammar valid.
tradeoffs: This increases accelerator compile work and does not establish accelerator runtime qualification.
reading_order: Makefile:USE_OMP_ICPX and default SYCL source lists
